delta_t_note: For the T sweep, T denotes the number of HiPPO/ODE discretization steps over a fixed solar time span; the plotted quantity is delta_t = (t_end - t_start) / T, not the number of solar observations.
flops_note: estimated_flops comes from torch.profiler(with_flops=True) on a single forward or forward-backward-step call. These are profiler estimates rather than hardware peak FLOPS.
